name: Tamachi Mahiru
source:
The protagonist's childhood friend who adores him like an older brother.

She has a volatile temperament that comes off as simple-minded. Much like a cat, she's always capricious and energetic.

[Translated from [url=http://craftwork.product.co.jp/CATALOG/adieu/chara/chara_03.html]official profile[/url]]
